line: The thought is not the thinker. Watch it pass, and notice you remain.
This loop keeps running only while you keep narrating it.
Notice that you are noticing. That is already the way out.
You do not have to finish this thought.
You need not attend every argument the mind convenes.
A mind that thinks it must solve the night rarely lets the night pass.
The mind is a wonderful servant, but a terrible master.
You are the sky. Everything else is just the weather.
Meditation is not evasion; it is a serene encounter with reality.
Between stimulus and response there is a space. In that space is our freedom.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
You have power over your mind — not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
Feelings come and go like clouds in a windy sky. Conscious breathing is my anchor.
Nothing is required of you in this second but to be here for it.
Loosen your grip on the outcome, and your hands are free to hold this moment.
Fear is loud because it loves you clumsily. Thank it, and breathe once more.
The present moment is the only moment available to us.
Worry is a rehearsal for a play that is rarely staged.
When I let go of what I am, I become what I might be.
Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
Muddy water, let stand, becomes clear.
The story of you is still being written. Set the pen down; let the page breathe.
Motion, not certainty, dissolves the fog. Take one honest step.
You are not behind. There is no line but the one you drew.
The wound is the place where the Light enters you.
Life is a series of natural changes. Do not resist them — that only creates sorrow.
Grief is love with nowhere to go. Let it move like weather, not walls.
We are all just walking each other home.
You are not a drop in the ocean. You are the entire ocean in a drop.
What the caterpillar calls the end, the rest of the world calls a butterfly.
The tears you carry are the shape of a love that was real.
Even this will soften. Not vanish — soften, until you can hold it.
You are the universe experiencing itself.
We don’t see things as they are; we see them as we are.
Be here now.
Who looks outside, dreams; who looks inside, awakes.
The ability to observe without evaluating is the highest form of intelligence.
Silence is not empty. It is full of answers.
Awareness is the ground you were seeking. You have always stood on it.
Knowing others is intelligence; knowing yourself is true wisdom.
The mind rehearses disaster because rehearsing feels like control.
You cannot think your way out of a thinking problem.
Not every thought is addressed to you. Some are just weather.
The question you keep asking has already been answered by your body.
Certainty is not the price of admission to the next hour.
Between the stimulus and the story, there is a gap. Live there.
No one has ever solved a life at three in the morning.
Nothing is happening. Your body is only rehearsing for something that is not.
Courage is not the absence of fear but the judgement that something else matters more.
You have survived every day you were certain you would not.
Do not lend the future your body. It has not asked for it.
Breathe out longer than you breathe in. The rest follows.
The cave you fear to enter holds the treasure you seek.
Begin badly. Beginning well is a story you tell after.
A door does not open because you understand the door.
Fall seven times, stand up eight.
What you are avoiding is smaller than the avoiding.
The obstacle is the way.
Grief is love with nowhere to go, so it stays where it was.
What we have once enjoyed we can never lose.
You do not get over it. You get larger around it.
Give sorrow words; the grief that does not speak whispers the o’er-fraught heart and bids it break.
Some mornings you will forget. That is not betrayal, it is rest.
Wherever you go, there you are.
The only way out is through.
Attention is the rarest and purest form of generosity.
This too shall pass. It is not a promise, it is a description.
Nothing you are looking for is anywhere but here.
The present moment is the only moment available to us, and it is the door to all moments.
Act without expectation.
To be fully alive is to feel that everything is possible.
You did not come this far only to come this far.
Rest is not the reward for the work. It is part of it.
What is to give light must endure burning.
